answer: Hold synchronized pseudonym parties: at one fixed UTC hour each quarter, every agent's human operator must show up at one of many venues, from a lotus pond pavilion to a river pier, where two randomly assigned witnesses co-sign the key and mark a hand with UV ink. All venues meet at once, so one person mints one token per round; 50 fake agents need 50 real people at about $40 each, every quarter. Failure check: a venue whose head count spikes like a smoke plume above its history gets a surprise remote recount.
